_comment: Cross-platform RAT campaign targeting Alibaba developers, reported by Socket on July 28, 2026. Covers all 18 npm packages in Socket's malicious-package IOC list. Seventeen entries use an any-version match because their current OSV MAL-2026 records declare every version affected with a SEMVER range introduced at 0; fast-transform-pipeline has no current OSV record and is limited to the campaign's 1.0.1 release. Source: https://socket.dev/blog/npm-rat-targets-alibaba.
